description: Company dossier for a US business, from a name and city/state and/or a website. One call returns: the matched business (Overture), phone, address and category, hours only if the business publishes them, domain age, email setup (MX/SPF/DMARC), certificate, website health and technology stack, SEC registration for public companies, a source, date and confidence on every field, honest 'not found' where unknown, and a short summary. Business facts only, no personal data. Charged only when the business or domain is found. Costs $0.15 per call (x402).

place.description: US city and state, or ZIP, e.g. 'Austin, TX'
